blobs.aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa:
# Example Tools

Helpers the example study uses to prepare its weekly summaries. Every function here reads a copy of the data and writes a new file, so the original export is never changed.
blobs.bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb:
# Setup

Install the package, then point it at the folder holding the weekly exports. The tool writes its results beside them and never overwrites an input file.
blobs.cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc:
[project]
name = "example-tools"
version = "0.3.0"
description = "Shared analysis helpers for the example study, with no external services."
requires-python = ">=3.11"
blobs.ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff:
# Copy this file to .env and fill in your own values.
EXAMPLE_DATA_DIR=C:\Path\To\Input
EXAMPLE_API_KEY=EXAMPLE_API_KEY
EXAMPLE_TIME_ZONE=UTC
blobs.1212121212121212121212121212121212121212:
# Example Notes

Written decisions for the example study, kept so somebody joining later can see why each choice was made rather than guessing at it.
